info.title: Tirosh VitalServer Runtime Control API
info.description: Local Runtime Control API contract for the macOS helper transition path and upcoming PWA client.

get.description: Aggregated read model for PWA status screens. It combines the same status, settings, release, install, and Vital Recorder observation data used by the native status UI.

get.summary: Subscribe to PWA runtime overview updates
get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for the aggregated PWA runtime overview. The local router emits a runtime-overview frame when the RuntimeControlOverview payload changes and heartbeat comments while idle.

schema.description: Long-lived SSE frames with id runtime-overview, event runtime-overview, and data as a JSON-encoded RuntimeControlOverview.

get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for runtime status updates. The local router keeps the connection open, emits a runtime-status frame when the RuntimeStatus payload changes, and sends heartbeat comments while idle.

schema.description: Long-lived SSE frames with id runtime-status, event runtime-status, and data as a JSON-encoded RuntimeStatus.

get.summary: Read runtime status and progress event history

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous response.

get.summary: Subscribe to runtime status and progress events
get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for runtime event updates. Each data frame carries one RuntimeEventDocument JSON object. The local router keeps the connection open, emits undelivered events, and sends heartbeat comments while idle.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Optional SSE resume marker. Clients should pass the latest received event id when reconnecting.

schema.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 timestamp lower bound for initial catch-up.

200.description: Runtime event SSE stream. Event names match RuntimeEventType values.

schema.description: SSE frames with id, event, and data fields. data is a JSON-encoded RuntimeEventDocument.

get.summary: Read helper and bundled release metadata

post.description: Requests a recoverable Redis backup from the runtime guest and returns the command result.

get.summary: Subscribe to local log text updates
get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for host log text updates. The local router keeps the connection open, emits a runtime-log frame when the selected log text changes, and sends heartbeat comments while idle.

schema.description: SSE frame with event runtime-log and data as a JSON-encoded RuntimeLogTextResponse.

200.description: Latest VitalDB observation snapshot, or null when unavailable.

get.description: Long-lived SSE stream for latest VitalDB observation snapshot changes.

get.summary: Read Vital Recorder history by vrcode
get.description: Aggregated VRecorder history derived from stored VitalDB observation snapshots. vrcode is the recorder identity key.

get.summary: Read one Vital Recorder by vrcode

200.description: Vital Recorder record, or null when no recorder has been observed for the requested vrcode.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Runtime Control token

NotImplemented.description: Endpoint exists in the contract but is not implemented by the current local read-only server

RuntimeControlOverview.description: Aggregated PWA read model aligned with the native runtime status UI.

RuntimeVitalRecorderSummary.description: PWA-friendly Vital Recorder summary derived from VitalDB observation first, then audit-proxy recorder connections as fallback.

RuntimeVitalRecorderHistory.description: Aggregated history of VRecorders keyed by vrcode.

guestLogSyncServiceLoaded.description: Whether the host guest-log-sync launchd service is loaded. This service keeps guest/container logs copied into the local logs directory.

sleepPreventionServiceLoaded.description: Whether the host sleep-prevention launchd service is loaded. When enabled, it prevents idle system sleep so VRecorder TCP streams, the host proxy, and the VM stay online.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for the representative VitalServer runtime start time. Clients should derive live uptime from this value.

nextCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page. Omitted or null when there is no next page.

RuntimeVMState.description: Observed VM lifecycle state. Unknown values are preserved by clients.

RuntimeVMError.description: Observed VM domain error code. The API may return newer codes; clients should preserve unknown values.
